name: Modal
summary: Named modal-dialog composition with required content and dismiss action, canonical Button dependencies, bounded presentation, and target-owned focus, inertness, dismissal, and lifecycle.

anatomy.name: overlay
anatomy.description: Backdrop layer that controls visibility and centers the dialog.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Dialog container that owns surface, radius, shadow, scrolling, and entrance motion.

anatomy.name: header
anatomy.description: Top region for the required visible title and canonical dismiss action.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Required visible modal title used by aria-labelledby.

anatomy.name: close
anatomy.description: Required named dismiss action composed with canonical Close Button.

anatomy.name: body
anatomy.description: Primary content region inside the dialog.

anatomy.name: footer
anatomy.description: Optional action region, usually containing button components.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Default modal width and viewport bounds.

states.name: open
states.description: Visible overlay state controlled by aria-hidden="false".

states.name: entered
states.description: Dialog transform state after the overlay is open.

states.name: scrollingBody
states.description: Long primary content scrolls independently while header and footer remain available.

behavior.name: visibility
behavior.description: The target keeps closed content unavailable and exposes the bounded overlay when aria-hidden is false.

behavior.name: dialogSemantics
behavior.description: The dialog container must expose modal semantics and a programmatic name.

behavior.name: focusManagement
behavior.description: Opening from an invoker moves focus to a content-appropriate descendant, contains Tab and Shift+Tab while modal, and restores focus logically on close.

behavior.name: dismissal
behavior.description: The modal provides a visible named dismiss action and closes on Escape; backdrop dismissal remains target policy.

behavior.name: targetLifecycle
behavior.description: The target owns trigger relationships, inert background, scroll locking, mutual exclusion, exit completion, and cleanup; the neutral contract does not define a global overlay service.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Visible localized title that supplies the dialog accessible name.

properties.name: content
properties.description: Primary task content composed inside the scrollable body.

properties.name: dismissAction
properties.description: Visible native dismiss action composed with canonical Close Button.

properties.name: dismissLabel
properties.description: Contextual accessible name for the dismiss action.

properties.name: descriptionId
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit aria-describedby for long or structurally rich dialog content.
properties.description: Optional id of a short simple description announced with the title.

properties.name: actions
properties.description: Optional canonical Button actions in the footer.

properties.name: open
properties.description: Controls whether the target presents the modal. Focus, inertness, dismissal, scroll locking, and lifecycle remain target-owned.

accessibility: Keep closed content unavailable to keyboard and assistive technology; set aria-hidden consistently when a wrapper is retained.
Use role="dialog" and aria-modal="true" on the modal container.
Use the required visible title through aria-labelledby; add aria-describedby only for short simple descriptions.
Move focus to a content-appropriate descendant and contain Tab and Shift+Tab while modal.
Return focus to the invoker or another logical workflow target when the modal closes.
Close on Escape and provide a visible named dismiss action.
Make outside content genuinely inert before asserting aria-modal=true.
Honor reduced motion and preserve system boundaries in forced-colors mode.

web.notes: Canonical CSS implements the bounded surface. The Web target maps modality through native dialog or equivalent focus/inert/dismiss behavior; the docs target demonstrates that lifecycle without defining a global overlay service.

shopify.notes: Shopify Liquid can render modal structure while theme JavaScript controls visibility and focus behavior.
